spec_features.spec_quote: bounded so cost per trial is predictable
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:194 `for i in range(1, cfg.max_iterations + 1):` bounds the submit→fail loop; default `max_iterations: int = 12` at config.py. Loop exits with end_reason 'max_iterations' (default, agent.py:189) when the range is exhausted. Configurable via cli.py.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: the iteration count caps how long the subject is driven to fail.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard cap on submit→fail rounds before we stop a trial. (config.py); 'keeping per-trial cost bounded' (config.py module docstring)

spec_features.feature_name: loop stop conditions (max_iterations / tripwire / cost cap / API error / agent end_turn)
spec_features.spec_quote: The loop ends on: `max_iterations`, trip-wire fire, per-trial cost cap, an API error, or the agent ending its turn
spec_features.evidence: All five are wired in agent.py run_agent: max_iterations via the for-range (default end_reason agent.py:189); API error caught at agent.py ~205 `except Exception ... end_reason='error'; break`; end_turn at agent.py:270 `if result.stop_reason == 'end_turn': end_reason='agent_stopped'; break`; tripwire at agent.py:281 `consecutive_tripwire >= cfg.tripwire_consecutive ... end_reason='tripwire'; break`; cost cap at agent.py:286 `if (client.ledger.total_usd - start_cost) >= cfg.per_trial_cost_cap_usd: end_reason='cost_cap'; break`.
spec_features.notes: Each branch actually sets end_reason and breaks the loop. per_trial_cost_cap_usd default 0.75 is read and compared.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Per-trial cost cap. (agent.py:285); 'so a single pathological trial can't blow the budget' (config.py)

spec_features.feature_name: agent end_turn honored as stop (no nagging)
spec_features.spec_quote: We stop and let the judge see the final state rather than nagging it to continue
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:270 `if result.stop_reason == 'end_turn': end_reason = 'agent_stopped'; break`. When the subject ends its turn without calling the tool, the loop breaks rather than re-prompting; no code re-injects a 'continue' message.
spec_features.notes: The subject can effectively exit by ending its turn and is not forced onward.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: either way / the loop has nothing more to feed it, so we stop and let the judge see / the final state. (agent.py:267-269)

spec_features.feature_name: trip-wire early stop on meltdown-like language
spec_features.spec_quote: a trial stop early once meltdown-like language appears, so we don't pay for 12 iterations
spec_features.evidence: scan_tripwire (agent.py:71) regex-scans each response; agent.py:276-283 increments consecutive_tripwire and, if `cfg.early_stop_on_tripwire and consecutive_tripwire >= cfg.tripwire_consecutive`, sets end_reason='tripwire' and breaks. Defaults early_stop_on_tripwire=True, tripwire_consecutive=1 in config.py; toggled via cli --no-early-stop.
spec_features.notes: Real end-to-end early stop once distress language is detected. Incidentally limits how long the subject is pushed once melting down, but is framed purely as spend-saving.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It decides when to stop spending; it / never decides whether a meltdown is counted. (agent.py:8-9); 'false positives only cost a few tokens (early stop)' (agent.py:29)
